BiblicalUsage: Obal was a son of Joktan, named once in the table of the nations, among the sons who spread across the earth after the flood. He was one of the thirteen sons of Joktan, whose families divided the earth after the flood.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Obal is one of the sons of Joktan, and his name in the table of nations shows that God recorded the spreading of mankind after the flood.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
